scope: Opt-in homelab control actions and the actual phone click-confirm-operation workflow
method: Four independent retained documentation personas reviewed the changed operational contract against engine, HTTP/UI code and evidence. Parent technical-writer consolidation; narrow follow-ups confirmed all remediations. Code-review/publication status is separate.

actions.finding: Old unconditional no-control/no-state-change assurances contradicted newly enabled homelab controls.
actions.remedy: Explicitly restrict observation-only behavior to actions=false. Keep socket enabling and container starts unconditionally absent; describe fixed opt-in stop/kill/remove operations and permission boundaries.
actions.evidence: docs/dashboard.md observer-mode and container paragraphs; all four persona follow-ups confirmed the correction.

actions.finding: Outcome-audit failure can leave a started-only journal even if an operation completed.
actions.remedy: Document initial-audit failure prevents dispatch, while failed post-attempt logging yields unknown completion. Missing terminal records do not prove failure; inspect fresh state before retrying.
actions.evidence: docs/dashboard.md action journal/recovery paragraph; principal and PM follow-ups confirmed; engine failure-injection tests cover the distinction.

actions.finding: Stop gracefully did not disclose the daemon's fixed10-second grace before possible force kill.
actions.remedy: Show10-second escalation in documentation and exact-target confirmation, with no new login or confirmation step.
actions.evidence: docs/dashboard.md container operations; dashboard/app.js confirmation; actual-app Node assertion; senior follow-up confirmed.

actions.finding: Trusted-LAN controls intentionally let allowed network users invoke enabled operations without additional manual credentials.
actions.remedy: Enable actions only for the intended homelab trust boundary. Keep TLS/private bind/client CIDRs and same-origin request gates; disable actions to restore observation-only behavior.

validated_scope.containers: Existing local Docker/Podman authority, full IDs, fresh target policy, stop/kill/remove stopped only, no volumes/force-remove/dependency recursion or arbitrary proxy
validated_scope.processes: Current-user identity, PID start-time plus pidfd binding, self/ancestors/core protection, fixed TERM/KILL only
validated_scope.services: Noncritical loaded user-service stop only; no root-service privileges
validated_scope.http: Opt-in, same-origin authenticated-policy JSON plus per-server nonce, typed bounded body, serialized operation and explicit results
validated_scope.ui: One exact-target confirmation, inert Cancel, duplicate prevention, no phone-side terminal or new login

evidence.real_browser: Actual LAN HTTPS at390px: cancelled owned process survived, confirmed SIGKILL, owned Podman container stop/kill/remove, owned transient user-service stop;5 successful operations with started+succeeded journal records and original volumes retained
evidence.fixtures: Only disposable owned field targets acted on and cleaned; no collateral targets or image pulls
evidence.ruggedness: One current REVIEW RUGGED for the action scope with rungs4/5

preserved_limits: System/root service controls are not granted.
Process signal delivery is not a promise the process exited or will not be restarted by its manager.
Self-signed trust, DHCP stability and absent physical-phone/separate-device verification remain environment limits.
Four unrelated existing strict documentation-site link warnings remain outside scope.
